projectSummary: A three-nerve description of pectoral innervation observed in all 29 dissections, which does not match the two-nerve account in the tertiary references. Carried into the contradiction map.

publication.statusSource: Crossref REST API works record plus the Crossref/Retraction Watch CSV export, both fetched 2026-09-13

notes: Abstract-only; a terminology difference between 'superior pectoral nerve' and the lateral/medial naming cannot be resolved without the full text.

study.intervention: Cadaveric topographic and histomorphometric study of the pectoral nerves.
study.population: Twenty-nine brachial plexuses from 13 embalmed and 5 fresh cadavers were examined under x3.5 loupe magnification, with nerve biopsy specimens harvested in 5 fresh cadavers for histomorphometry.

title: The anatomy of the pectoral nerves and their significance in brachial plexus reconstruction.
